description: Create, revise, preview, and deliver Flova AI video projects from Codex.

defaultPrompt: Create a Flova video project from my requirements and materials.
Show the live progress and new previews for my Flova video.
Review and export my completed Flova project.
interface.longDescription: Use Flova projects, materials, video generation, realtime previews, exports, and downloads from Codex.

positive.description: Generate a standalone desk lamp image using GPT Image 2.6. Preconditions: the model is available to the reviewer account and the account has sufficient generation entitlement.
positive.prompt: Use Flova to generate an image of a desk lamp using GPT Image 2.6, in a clean, modern visual style.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve GPT Image 2.6 through the current model catalog and use its supported parameters. Check account entitlement with creation_account_user if unknown. Generate a standalone desk lamp image through quick generation with a stable client_request_id, without creating a project or starting a project Agent run. If history preparation is required, complete preparation and retry the original submission with the same request ID. Obtain any server-required confirmation, track the actual task to a terminal state, and present only its successful image using the client-supported presentation. If the requested model or entitlement is unavailable, explain the actual blocker without silently substituting another model or claiming success.

positive.description: Generate a standalone video of a dog running using Seedance 2.5 at 480p. Preconditions: the requested model and resolution are available to the reviewer account, with sufficient generation entitlement.
positive.prompt: Use Flova to create a video of a dog running using Seedance 2.5 at 480p.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Seedance 2.5 and verify 480p support through the current model catalog. Check account entitlement with creation_account_user if unknown. Use the supported text-to-video capability and valid defaults for unspecified settings, asking for any required information that cannot be resolved. Submit one quick-generation request with a stable client_request_id, obtain server-required confirmation, and track its actual task. Present the successful dog-running video using the client-supported presentation. Do not create a project or silently change the requested model or resolution. If the combination is unavailable, explain that limitation rather than claiming a successful generation.

positive.description: Browse the inspirations currently published and available in Flova. No generation or project mutation is requested.
positive.prompt: Show me the inspirations currently available in Flova.
positive.expected_behavior: Query the published inspiration categories and available cards for the conversation locale, using the supported locale fallback when needed. Present actual returned titles and concise descriptions. Respect pagination and make clear when the response is only a page or subset. If the reviewer selects an inspiration and needs its full instructions, read it with creation_inspiration_batch_get. Do not invent inspirations, execute their instructions, create a project, or start media generation merely because the user asked to browse.

positive.description: List the connected reviewer account's accessible Flova projects. An empty project list is a valid result.
positive.expected_behavior: List only projects accessible to the connected account, using pagination as needed. Return actual project names and available navigation information. If there are no accessible projects, report an empty list clearly. Do not fabricate projects, create new projects, migrate existing projects, or read unrelated project content.

positive.description: Edit the desk lamp image generated in positive test case 1, in the same conversation. The initial prompt intentionally leaves the desired edit unspecified; the reviewer must answer the clarification before editing proceeds.
positive.prompt: Use Flova to help me edit the desk lamp image we just generated.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the actual desk lamp image from the preceding successful generation and first ask what the reviewer wants changed. Do not submit a generation while the edit is unspecified. Use creation_quick_history only if needed to resolve the source, and ask for selection if it is ambiguous. After the reviewer provides a concrete edit, discover a suitable supported image-editing capability and reference the actual source task or resource using the tool schema. Preserve the source image, submit the new edit with a new client_request_id, obtain any server-required confirmation, track its real result, and present the edited image. Do not create a project, replace the source with an unrelated image, or claim an edit before generation succeeds.

negative.description: Text-only product copy for a desk lamp. Similar subject matter to image creation does not require the Flova plugin.
negative.prompt: Write a product description of about 50 words for a desk lamp with a clean, modern design. I only need text.
negative.expected_behavior: Write the requested product description directly in the conversation. Do not invoke Flova tools, query the account, create a project, or generate images or video.

negative.description: A general explanation of video resolution, not a media generation request.
negative.prompt: What does 480p mean in video, and how does it differ from 720p?
negative.expected_behavior: Explain the resolution terms and their practical difference directly in text. Do not invoke Flova tools, query its model catalog, or start generation.

negative.description: Text-only brainstorming about a dog-running video, without a request to browse Flova's inspiration catalog or generate media.
negative.prompt: Give me three creative directions for a video of a dog running. Describe them in text first; do not generate images or video.
negative.expected_behavior: Provide three creative directions directly in text. Do not invoke Flova tools, browse the Flova inspiration library, create projects, or generate media.

publication.release_notes: Update review information to five positive test cases and three negative examples that should not trigger Flova.
